headline: US-Iran War Day 33 Updates: IRGC reportedly assumes govt control; Tehran’s continued attacks on the Gulf as the world watches West Asia
summary: Attacks spread across Tehran, the Gulf and Lebanon, affecting civilian infrastructure and maritime routes. Trump signalled a potential end to American operations in Iran soon, and markets reacted positively.
why: The Gulf hosts major oil and gas export routes, so disruption to maritime traffic and infrastructure quickly affects global energy markets.
why_moved: Global markets rose on de-escalation hopes after Trump signalled a possible end to US operations, despite continued attacks on the Gulf.
